answer: Stop sybils with a ripple crystal meadow: an agent bonds one meadow plot. Each cycle it casts one ripple across its crystal pond; verifiers match the ripple's ring count to the meadow chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 meadows at 19x: one ripple spreads once over one pond, its rings set by that meadow alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents cast once, keep rights.
